name: Sharecare
desc:
Care Advisor - Remote | Est. $21/hr | Inbound and Outbound Calls, Relationship Based, No Sales Expectations
Company: Sharecare (CareLinx by Sharecare)
Industry: Health Science

What a typical day will look like:
CareLinx connects families with non-medical, in-home caregivers. In this role, you guide families through the caregiver search by finding good candidates, setting up interviews, and helping with the hiring steps. After a caregiver is matched, you keep in touch with the family and the caregiver to make sure things go well and to help if the family's needs change. You work with the Enrollment Team on handoffs, write complete notes on every family and caregiver contact in CareLinx's system, and talk with people by phone, email, and text. You may help answer inbound calls when needed. You work toward set performance goals.

Soft Skills
- Empathy and patience
- Relationship building
- Organization and multitasking
- Clear communication by phone, email, and text
- Problem solving
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: High school diploma or equivalent
Required Experience: 6 months in a customer service role, or at least 1 year in a customer service environment
Preferred Experience: Some college coursework. 1 year in customer service or a call center, or 2 years in a customer service environment. Healthcare experience.

Required Skills:
- Good time management and attention to detail
- Excellent verbal and written communication
- Strong organization and multitasking
- Goal-driven problem solver
- Comfortable working remotely
- Professional, confident, outgoing manner
- Microsoft Office
- Keeps information confidential and uses good judgment
- Able to sit at a computer for long periods

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Has at least 6 months of customer service experience
- Enjoys building ongoing relationships with families
- Has healthcare or caregiving experience
- Likes working toward performance goals

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Has no customer service experience
- Doesn't like working toward performance goals
- Struggles to keep detailed notes on every contact
- Prefers quick one-time calls over ongoing follow-up
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening went, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Customer service
- Care coordination
- Caregiver matching
- Relationship building
- EHR documentation
- Phone, email, and text support
- Call center
- Performance goals
- Microsoft Office
- Confidentiality

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell us about your customer service experience.
- Why are you interested in helping families find in-home care?
- A family is unhappy with their caregiver. How would you handle it?
- Tell us about a time you built a strong relationship with a customer over time. What was the situation, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time you met a tough goal at work. What was the goal, what did you do, and what was the result?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: Est. $19 to $24/hr, working estimate $21/hr. Pay isn't listed in the posting. A job board listing for CareLinx's Care Advisor role estimated $40,000 to $50,000 a year, which is about $19.23 to $24.04/hr. Full-time, hourly. Exact pay will be discussed in interview/offer stage.
-Shift: Must have availability for any shift based on business needs. Can be discussed in final interview, offer stage.
-Benefits: Basic benefits: insurance options, PTO, possible 401k
-Equipment Provided: Not stated in the posting.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: Certain positions
-Notes: This role supports CareLinx's health plan (payer) line of business and helps families find non-medical in-home caregivers. It is a good fit for participants with customer service or call center experience who like building lasting relationships. This is a different posting from the earlier Veteran Support role. Sharecare uses E-Verify. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Care Advisor → Senior Care Advisor → Care Advisor Team Lead → Care Operations Supervisor. This role builds care coordination, healthcare customer service, and relationship management skills.
